newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa could move lower, support threatened.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa could move lower, support threatened.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures remain vulnerable to a sell-off and could slide back under the psychological 1,000 stg mark basis July to target key support at 980 stg, technical analysts said on Friday.
Although July managed to hold above 1,000 stg throughout Thursday's session, short-term momentum indicators suggest that upside potential is limited.
"Maybe there is a little more upside in the short term but I think the market remains vulnerable to a sell-off," said Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden.
"The danger point is 980 on the downside -- I personally think the market is going to fail and break down below 980," he said.
Initial resistance was placed at a cluster of short-term moving averages arranged around 1,020 stg, followed by 1,050 and the double-top peaks of 1,061 and 1,065 stg.
But analysts have also warned that sellers lurking around 1,060 stg could hamper upside progress, as July saw two hefty slumps soon after the two peaks were hit.
Traders called the London market to open broadly unchanged from Thursday's close.
On the downside July could quickly slide down to a chart gap between 921 and 928 stg if critical support at 980 stg was breached, Haylor said.
